headerPolicy: Every vendored file carries: Vendored from generalaction/emdash@c1af543 — Apache-2.0; See src/vendor/emdash/hooks/LICENSE.md. Adaptations are listed in each file header and in the changeSummary below. Existing copyright notices inside source are never stripped.
vendoringPolicy: Pinned copy only — no @emdash/* npm dependency, no upstream client ids/tokens/endpoints. Hook command builders were re-pointed from emdash's hook server (http://127.0.0.1:$EMDASH_HOOK_PORT/hook, X-Emdash-* headers) to NexusIDE's own loopback gate ($NEXUS_HOOK_URL + authorization: Bearer $NEXUS_GATE_TOKEN, per-pane token) and the marker renamed EMDASH_HOOK_PORT → NEXUS_HOOK_STATUS.

files.changeSummary: Verbatim copy (CanonicalHookEvent, NotificationType, HOOK_EVENTS, HookRegistration) + attribution header.
defaultHookEventParser + extractProviderSessionId verbatim; only the import path was repointed at the local vendored hooks-types module.

Command transport re-pointed: $NEXUS_HOOK_URL (POST /hook/status on the Nexus gate server) replaces http://127.0.0.1:$EMDASH_HOOK_PORT/hook; authorization: Bearer $NEXUS_GATE_TOKEN replaces X-Emdash-Token/X-Emdash-Pty-Id (the per-pane bearer identifies the pane); event type + CLI flavor travel as X-Nexus-Hook-Event/X-Nexus-Hook-Flavor; marker EMDASH_HOOK_PORT → NEXUS_HOOK_STATUS (env-assignment prefix on POSIX, echo prefix on Windows). Structure preserved: curl || true, PowerShell SilentlyContinue + base64 EncodedCommand, stdin/fixed-body payload split, filterUserHooks.

Only the pure entry builders (nested/flat/minimal) and marker-aware merge helpers vendored. Emdash's async PluginFs lifecycle (readHooks/writeHooks/deleteHooks/getHooksInstalled, readTomlConfig/writeTomlConfig) intentionally dropped — Nexus writes native configs per-spawn in src/main/orch/hook-status-config.ts with its own atomic-write + smol-toml helpers.

parseClaudeHookEvent (permission/approval text classification) + UserPromptSubmit/Notification/Stop spec table consolidated into flavors.ts; commands come from the Nexus-adapted builders. The buildNestedJsonHookConfig PluginFs wrapper is not vendored (see hook-config.ts entry).

parseCodexHookEvent (agent-turn-complete → stop, fixed notification_type mapping, session-start id extraction incl. resource_id) + Stop/PermissionRequest/SessionStart specs + makeCodexSessionStartCommand consolidated into flavors.ts. Nexus extension: added UserPromptSubmit → start (without it Codex panes could never report working). NOT vendored: legacy .codex/hooks.json migration and `notify` cleanup (Nexus never writes the user's real Codex profile; status hooks ship as per-session -c argv overrides).

KIMI_HOOK_SPECS table (SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure/Notification/Stop/StopFailure/SessionEnd) consolidated into flavors.ts. The addKimiHooksToConfigText inline-patcher and the dual-path (.kimi-code/.kimi) PluginFs writer are not vendored — Nexus merges the flat hooks array into the per-session KIMI_CODE_HOME overlay config.toml.

parseGrokHookEvent (all notifications are permission prompts) + 9-event spec table + GROK_SESSION_ID session command consolidated into flavors.ts. The PluginFs writer for .grok/hooks/emdash.json is not vendored — Nexus writes hooks/nexus.json inside the per-session GROK_HOME overlay.

All three upstream cases ported (POSIX stdin shape, Windows base64 shape without quoted cmd body, marker prefix) with expectations updated to the Nexus transport; added filterUserHooks, fixed-body notification and env-only-auth coverage.

The parseCodexHookEvent cases (agent-turn-complete → stop, idle/permission notification mapping, session-start session_id/resource_id extraction) ported against flavors.ts. Upstream's PluginFs file-lifecycle cases (legacy hooks.json migration, deleteHooks) are not vendored because that lifecycle layer was not vendored. Added Claude/Grok classification, flavor dispatch and spec-table sanity coverage.

Nexus-authored suite: upstream has NO dedicated parse-hook-event test (the default parser is only exercised indirectly via plugin tests). This pins the documented routing table directly since the Nexus /hook/status endpoint depends on it standalone.
Nexus-authored suite pinning the pure-builder + marker-dedupe merge semantics (user-hook preservation, idempotent rewrite) that upstream only covers through its async PluginFs behaviors.
Verbatim license copy shipped next to the vendored code.

Verbatim copy (ProxyJump/ProxyCommand process transports: SAFE_* char allowlists, BatchMode ssh -W argv builder, % token expansion, SIGTERM→SIGKILL reaping, bounded stderr debug logs) + attribution header. The header also documents the Nexus rule that TransportResult sockets only reach ssh2 through src/main/remote/ssh/proxied-connect-config.ts, which requires a hostVerifier — upstream connected without one.

Verbatim port of all upstream cases (argv building incl. multi-hop and IPv6, option-injection rejection, token expansion + unsafe host rejection, duplex error propagation, EPIPE handling, shell-spawn shape, SIGTERM→SIGKILL escalation, bounded debug logs) + attribution header.

Recursive Include parser with cycle guard, vendored alongside (not replacing) Nexus's lean orca-derived parser in src/main/remote/ssh/ssh-config-parser.ts. Adaptations: the `glob` npm package import was replaced with node:fs/promises `glob` + stat() filtering (npm glob is only a transitive undeclared dep in Nexus and has no installed types; mirrors { nodir: true }); the `@shared/core/ssh/ssh` import was repointed to the local vendored ./ssh-config-host interface; the orphaned trailing doc comment was dropped; file renamed kebab-case. Parsing behavior (directives, quotes, tilde expansion, ProxyJump/ProxyCommand none-handling, ForwardAgent values, wildcard-skip) unchanged.

All five upstream cases ported verbatim (multi-alias + proxy/forwarding preview fields, user-less aliases, case-insensitive HostName lookup, Include listing, repeated-Include application). Nexus-added describe pins behaviors upstream shipped untested: cyclic Include graphs terminate with each file read once, self-include cut, full-line comments/blank lines skipped, wildcard-only Host blocks dropped while concrete aliases survive.

Verbatim copy (canonical `ssh -G` resolution: alias allowlist validation, parseSshGOutput with repeated/none values, execFile runner with timeout + maxBuffer + SIGKILL, IdentityAgent socket env expansion) + attribution header.

Verbatim port of all upstream cases (ssh -G output parsing, option-like alias rejection, fake-ssh stderr propagation, timeout, maxBuffer bound, real ssh -G against a temp config via injected runner, IdentityAgent env expansion) + attribution header.

Stable reconnect-surviving ssh2 client reference + channel health reporting (update/invalidate/isConnected, exec/execPty/sftp wrappers). Adaptations: `ssh2` type imports repointed to the Nexus-authored minimal ./ssh2-types surface (@types/ssh2 not installed; ssh2 is an optionalDependency). NOT vendored: the remote-shell-profile capture/cache layer (getRemoteShellProfile/refreshRemoteShellProfile + RemoteShellProfileState) — it pulls emdash's execution-context/userEnv/terminal-settings module web; re-add with its dependencies if a future wave needs remote env capture.

The two upstream channel-health cases are verbatim. The remote-shell-profile suite was dropped with the profile layer it covered; a Nexus-authored 'stable client reference' describe pins the reconnect-survival semantics (unavailable throws, update swaps the live client, invalidate drops it) that upstream only exercised indirectly through the profile tests.

forwardOut tunnel with IPv4/IPv6 loopback fallback, retry restricted to SSH_OPEN_CONNECT_FAILED, EADDRINUSE local-port fallback and first-error surfacing. Adaptations limited to import repoints: ClientChannel → ./ssh2-types, SshClientProxy → local vendored ./ssh-client-proxy. Behavior unchanged. Not yet wired into Nexus's existing src/main/integrations/port-forward.ts (next wave candidate).

Verbatim port of all six upstream cases (loopback round-trip through forwardOut, EADDRINUSE fallback, IPv4→IPv6 family fallback, no fallback on non-connect reasons, first-error surfacing when all families fail, clean close without uncaught exceptions) with only the type imports repointed (./ssh2-types, ./ssh-client-proxy).
Verbatim copy (quoteShellArg/quoteCshArg single-quote escaping, isValidEnvVarName) + attribution header; file renamed kebab-case. Upstream ships no dedicated test for this module.

Only the SshConfigHost interface (the @emdash/* type the config parser consumed) is vendored; the rest of upstream's shared SSH contract (IPC channel table, connection rows, health types) is not consumed by Nexus.
Verbatim license copy shipped next to the vendored SSH code.
